name: Transnistria
summary: Red with a broad green horizontal band, and a gold hammer and sickle with a star in the upper hoist. It is based on the Soviet-era flag of the Moldavian SSR, used by the breakaway state that split from Moldova in 1990.
origin: Transnistria declared itself a separate republic in 1990 and fought a brief war with Moldova in 1992. It kept the flag of the Moldavian SSR, which it confirmed in its constitution of 2000. A version without the hammer and sickle is used as the state flag in some contexts, and the Russian flag is co-official.

symbols.name: Hammer and sickle
symbols.description: Gold emblem with a star above, in the upper hoist.

facts: It is one of the last flags still flown officially with a hammer and sickle.
Transnistria is not recognised by any UN member state.
Russian troops have been stationed there since 1992.
